title: Io kneads itself into the most volcanic body known
body: Jupiter's tides flex Io's rocky body as it orbits, generating frictional heat that drives hundreds of volcanoes and constantly repaves the surface. Voyager 1 photographed a plume in 1979 where geology expected a dead cratered moon. Tidal flexing, the same physics lengthening Earth's day, here runs a planetary furnace.
